description: Sixteen gate outputs, each one high while the three inputs stand in one particular combination of equal, less than, greater than and not equal

params.text: Switched up to 10V a true comparison puts 10V on its output; switched down to 5V it puts 5V there

inputs.text: The first of the three voltages compared; it is measured against IN B and never directly against IN C
The middle of the three voltages; it is measured against IN A for the left half of each output's name and against IN C for the right half
The third of the three voltages compared; it is measured against IN B and never directly against IN A

outputs.text: High while IN A is within 0.01V of IN B and IN B is within 0.01V of IN C
High while IN A is within 0.01V of IN B and IN B is below IN C
High while IN A is within 0.01V of IN B and IN B is above IN C
High while IN A is within 0.01V of IN B and IN B is further than 0.01V from IN C
High while IN A is below IN B and IN B is within 0.01V of IN C
High while IN A is below IN B and IN B is below IN C
High while IN A is below IN B and IN B is above IN C
High while IN A is below IN B and IN B is further than 0.01V from IN C
High while IN A is above IN B and IN B is within 0.01V of IN C
High while IN A is above IN B and IN B is below IN C
High while IN A is above IN B and IN B is above IN C
High while IN A is above IN B and IN B is further than 0.01V from IN C
High while IN A is further than 0.01V from IN B and IN B is within 0.01V of IN C
High while IN A is further than 0.01V from IN B and IN B is below IN C
High while IN A is further than 0.01V from IN B and IN B is above IN C
High while IN A is further than 0.01V from IN B and IN B is further than 0.01V from IN C

notes: equal means within 0.01V of each other, and not equal means further apart than that.
the comparisons are made at the audio sample rate, so fast inputs give very short pulses. Slew or filter the inputs for longer ones.
every output rests at 0V while its comparison is false; none of them goes negative.
